## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use for the single normalized addr-spec of a first-class [`gmeow:EmailAddress`](../classes/gmeow-EmailAddress.md) — the canonical whole, distinct from its parsed local and domain parts.

### Avoid when

- Avoid asserting more than one value per address (it is functional) and avoid using it for the bare agent-level shortcut (that is [`gmeow:email`](gmeow-email.md)); an email value is sensitive personal data, never for public projection.

### How to use

- Carry the normalized addr-spec on the [`EmailAddress`](../classes/gmeow-EmailAddress.md); derive [`gmeow:localPart`](gmeow-localPart.md) and [`gmeow:domainPart`](gmeow-domainPart.md) from it, and keep its personal sensitivity so it is withheld from public consumers.

### Examples

- ex:lillithEmail [`gmeow:addressValue`](gmeow-addressValue.md) "lillith@example.org".

### Use For Consumers

- [`gmeow:consumerAgentMemory`](../individuals/gmeow-consumerAgentMemory.md)
